stories.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander tallies 32 points in Thunder's win over Spurs
NFLPA calls for 'full investigation' into Eagles QB Hurts' medical care
stories.summary: After NFL chief medical officer Allen Sills staunchly defended the process involving Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts and his blood clot issue Tuesday, the NFLPA issued a statement calling for a "full investigation" into his medical care.

stories.title: Day: Ohio State planning to be without injured Sayin through postseason
stories.summary: Buckeyes coach Ryan Day declined to put a timeline on Julian Sayin's recovery but said they are planning to move forward without him through the rest of the year.

stories.title: Sixers rally in LeBron's debut, spoiling Knicks' championship celebration
stories.summary: LeBron James began his NBA-record 24th season as Philadelphia sent an opening-night message that it will be a contender for New York's NBA title.

stories.title: Source: Red Wings' Larkin stretches list of trade options to 10 teams
stories.summary: Dylan Larkin, whose trade request was made public last June, told the Red Wings he'd be willing to move to at least seven additional teams, bringing his list of options to 10, a source confirmed to ESPN.
